bibliography_conversion.from: 93 bibitem entries in the LaTeX draft
bibliography_conversion.method: parsed author, title, venue and url from each entry and emitted bib records under the same keys so existing citation keys keep working
bibliography_conversion.defect_found_and_fixed: the first parser assumed a quoted-title format and produced records whose author field swallowed the title; it was rewritten against the actual emphasised-title format and checked for short titles and missing years, both of which came back at zero

assertion_behaviour: each table cell asserts the counts it reads, so a receipt that no longer agrees fails the render
not_yet_swapped: the submission entry point still builds from the LaTeX draft; the swap waits until all five chapters exist, because a submission missing its later chapters would fail its own gates
